data.name: Alrick
data.gender_notes: Alrick is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old High German 'alah' meaning 'all' and 'ric' meaning 'ruler' or 'power'. The name Alrick can be interpreted as 'ruler of all' or 'rich ruler'. This name was popular among Germanic tribes and was brought to England by the Normans. The name Alrick carries the meaning “Ruler, Power, Rich” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alrick usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, power, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלריק נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'אל' ו'ריק', שמשמעותן אלוהים הוא המלך שלי. השם אלריק הוא שילוב של שני המרכיבים הללו, שמעידים על קשר חזק עם האל הבורא.

in_greek.name: Άλρικ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο βασιλιάς μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Άλρικ πιθανότατα προέρχεται από τις Γερμανικές ρίζες, αλλά έχει συσχετιστεί με την ελληνική γλώσσα μέσω της Χριστιανικής παράδοσης. Το όνομα πιθανότατα σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο βασιλιάς μου'.

in_latin.name: Alricus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alricus originem ducit ex Germanicis linguis, sed in traditione Christiana Latina adoptatum est. Significatio nominis est 'Deus est meus rex', quod relationem fortis cum Deo indicat.

in_english.name: Alrick
in_english.meaning: God is my ruler or God is my king
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alrick originates from Germanic roots but has been adopted into Christian traditions. It is derived from the Old High German words 'adal' meaning 'noble' and 'ric' meaning 'ruler' or 'king'. Thus, Alrick signifies 'God is my ruler' or 'God is my king', reflecting a strong spiritual connection and devotion to God. Historically, names with similar roots were common among nobility and clergy, indicating a person of spiritual or noble leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alrick represents the idea of a powerful and ruling figure, which may have been revered or admired in the context of feudal society. The name's Germanic origins may also hint at the influence of the Vikings and their Norse gods in Anglo-Saxon England. Alrick may have been a name given to a leader or a warrior, reflecting the values of strength and courage.
data.spiritual_significance: Alrick's name can also be viewed through a spiritual lens, as a reminder of God's sovereignty and reign over all things. 'Alrick, ruler of all', could signify a belief in a higher power and the submission to it. Additionally, the name's historical background ties it to notions of justice, protection, and service, which can be seen as virtues worth striving for in one's daily life.
